# Promptly

> A personal, local-first AI prompt library — save, organize, search, and reuse your favorite prompts. Runs entirely in the browser with local storage; no sign-up, no servers.

## Features

- Save prompts with tags and nested categories
- Reusable {{variables}} you fill in before copying
- Command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K), full-text search, and filters
- Version history and automatic local snapshots
- Markdown editing/preview, open in ChatGPT or Claude, share via link
- Import/export JSON backups; installable offline PWA

## Pages

- [Promptly](/): The main prompt library — create, categorize, tag, search, favorite, duplicate, share, import, and export reusable AI prompts.
